figures.caption: Figure S5. Configurations of BH4⁻ orientational combinations (O1–O1, O1–O2, O2–O1, O2– O2) in the Li5PS4(BH4)2 argyrodite structure, where both Wyckoff 4a and 4d sites are fully substituted with BH4⁻ anions. Each label indicates the specific orientation assigned to BH4⁻ units at the 4a and 4d sites, respectively (e.g., O1–O2 denotes O1 at 4a and O2 at 4d). O1 (red) indicates BH4⁻ tetrahedron aligned with the neighboring PS43⁻ unit, whereas O2 (green) denotes anti-alignment. PS43⁻ tetrahedra are shown with P in blue and S in yellow, and Li ions as purple spheres.

figures.label: S6
figures.caption: Figure S6. Calculated bulk Li+ ion conductivity (𝜎bulk ) of Li5PS4(BH4)2 as a function of crystallinity (𝜒𝑐). The conductivity follows the empirical relation σbulk = σcalc ⋅χ𝑐 7.14 derived from halide-substituted argyrodite systems, showing exponential growth with increasing crystallinity. In this study, 𝜒𝑐 = 0.6 was assumed, yielding corrected conductivity of 7.2 mScm1.
